scope: profiles H1330/H1750, AmdSetup offsets, endianness and stale-artifact audit; strategy-only static review; no ROM/NVRAM/hardware/register action
limits: Bytes for the six fields come from the extracted CLV CbsSetupDxe PE32 (sha256 7ff717d5...); the module is not a verbatim ROM substring because the FFS section is compressed, so provenance rests on the recorded extractor hash, not on a byte-substring match.
IFR record type/option bytes are static requests; nothing here shows that firmware applies them, that NVRAM persists them, or that any clock ratio becomes 1:1:1.
UclkDiv1M0 'Enabled' remains an undecoded enum byte; Memory Clock Speed values are option-table indices, not a MHz/50 arithmetic scaling.
